name: Mahindra 575 DI XP Plus Tractor (47 HP)
shortDescription: 47 HP multi-purpose tractor engineered for heavy tillage, rotavator, and haulage operations.
fullTechnicalDescription: Equipped with a 2979 cc 4-cylinder ELS direct-injection diesel engine generating 192 Nm peak torque at 1300 RPM. Features dual-clutch partial constant mesh 8F+2R transmission, 1500 kg advanced hydraulic lift with automatic draft control (ADDC), and dual-acting power steering for fatigue-free Malwa black soil cultivation.
description: Heavy-duty fuel-efficient 47 HP tractor suited for heavy tillage, rotavator operations, haulage, and sowing in Malwa black soil conditions. Includes an experienced operator.
cancellationPolicy: Free cancellation up to 6 hours before scheduled start. 20% charge within 6 hours.

name: Shaktiman Semi-Champion Rotavator (7 Feet)
shortDescription: 7-foot heavy-duty rotary tiller with 54 boron steel blades for fine seedbed preparation.
fullTechnicalDescription: Features a multi-speed heavy-duty cast iron gearbox compatible with 540 and 1000 RPM PTO inputs. Fitted with 54 heat-treated L-type boron steel blades on spiral flange rotors, side gear drive lubrication in oil bath, and adjustable depth skid shoes for up to 7 inches tilling depth.
description: Produces fine tilth in a single or double pass. Ideal for pulverizing cotton stalks, soybean stubble, and preparing seedbeds for wheat and gram.
cancellationPolicy: Free cancellation up to 12 hours prior to scheduled dispatch.

name: National Multi-Crop Seed-cum-Fertilizer Drill
shortDescription: 9-tyne dual-hopper seed drill with calibrated fluted roller meters for wheat, pulses, and oilseeds.
fullTechnicalDescription: Dual separate heavy-gauge powder-coated hoppers for 50 kg certified seed and 60 kg granular fertilizer. Ground-wheel driven transmission with variable nylon fluted rollers, individual shut-off levers, inverted T-type tungsten carbide tipped furrow openers, and spring-loaded depth control.
description: Calibrated precision seed drill for wheat, gram (chana), mustard, and soybean. Delivers uniform seed depth and basal fertilizer placement.
cancellationPolicy: Free cancellation up to 4 hours in advance.

name: Spectra Precision Dual-Slope Laser Land Leveller
model: GL722 Precision Transmitter with 7ft Scraper Bucket
capacity: Up to 1.5 - 2 Acres leveled per hour
shortDescription: Precision laser leveller with 900m rotating transmitter and hydraulic scraper bucket.
fullTechnicalDescription: Class 3R rotating diode laser with 360-degree receiver mast and proportional solenoid hydraulic spool valve. Mounted on a 2.1m scraper bucket with high-carbon cutting edge, dual slope compensation (-10% to +25%), reducing irrigation volume by 25-30% while maximizing crop stand uniformity.

specifications.Water Saving: Up to 30% reduction in irrigation water requirements

description: Top-tier dual-slope laser leveller. Decreases irrigation water consumption, prevents waterlogging, and ensures uniform fertilizer distribution.
cancellationPolicy: Cancellation allowed with 24 hours prior notice.

name: ASPEE Tractor-Mounted 600L Boom Sprayer
shortDescription: 600-litre tank with 40-foot folding boom and anti-drip ceramic nozzles for bio-spray application.
fullTechnicalDescription: UV-stabilized 600L virgin polyethylene tank with hydraulic jet agitator and chemical inductor hopper. Triple ceramic plunger pump operating at 40 bar pressure driven by tractor PTO. 12-meter 5-section folding lattice boom with 24 anti-drip diaphragm check valves and ISO standard ceramic flat fan nozzles.
description: Uniform mist application for bio-pesticides and foliar micronutrients. Minimizes chemical wastage and exposure for farm workers.
cancellationPolicy: Full refund if cancelled before 8 AM on the booking date.

name: Lemken Opal 090 2-Bottom Hydraulic Reversible Plough
shortDescription: 2-bottom reversible plough for deep subsoil inversion and root aerating.
fullTechnicalDescription: Micro-alloyed box section frame (90x90x7mm) with single-acting hydraulic turnover cylinder. Pointed bar shares and disc coulters provide seamless trash burial up to 35cm depth with automatic shear bolt overload protection for rocky soil conditions.
description: Deep primary tillage implement for inverting hardpan soils, burying weed residues, and aerating the root zone.
cancellationPolicy: Cancellation allowed up to 12 hours prior.

name: Preet 987 Self-Propelled Multi-Crop Combine Harvester
capacity: 14 Feet Cutter Bar with Straw Chopper (SMS)
shortDescription: 101 HP self-propelled multi-crop combine harvester equipped with Super-SMS straw management system.
fullTechnicalDescription: Powered by an Ashok Leyland 6-cylinder BS-IV 101 HP turbocharged water-cooled engine. Features a 14-foot floating cutter bar with Schumacher knife drive system, rasp bar threshing drum (600mm dia x 1260mm width), 5-straw walker separation unit, 2400-litre grain tank with fast unloading auger, and rear Super Straw Management System (SMS).
description: Clean harvesting for paddy, wheat, soybean, and gram with negligible grain loss (<1.5%). Includes Super-SMS ensuring clean seeding for subsequent crops.
cancellationPolicy: Requires 24 hours cancellation notice due to transport logistics.

name: Bakhsish Super Seeder (Crop Residue Sower)
capacity: Direct Sowing in standing paddy stubble
shortDescription: Simultaneous paddy stubble mulching and direct wheat seed drilling implement.
fullTechnicalDescription: Front-mounted PTO powered rotary rotor with 54 wear-resistant curved blades that chop and mulch standing stubble into the soil. Integrated rear fluted roller seed drill with inverted T boot openers and rubber press compaction wheels, allowing zero-till planting without burning stubble.
description: Eliminates stubble burning by simultaneously chopping straw and drilling wheat seeds in one single pass.

name: Kirloskar 10HP Mobile Diesel Irrigation Pump Set
shortDescription: Mobile diesel irrigation pump set with 90,000 L/hr discharge and 100m layflat hose.
fullTechnicalDescription: Kirloskar air-cooled 10 HP diesel engine direct-coupled to a high-efficiency centrifugal non-clog pump. Delivers 1500 LPM at 20m head with integrated vacuum primer, 4-inch quick-camlock suction assembly, and 100m reinforced layflat delivery hose on road-towable pneumatic wheel cart.
description: High-delivery portable centrifugal pumping unit for lifting water from open wells, farm ponds, or canal outlets to distant fields.
cancellationPolicy: Cancel up to 2 hours before pick-up.

name: Grewal Heavy Multi-Crop Stationary Thresher
shortDescription: 40 HP tractor PTO driven multi-crop thresher with dual aspiration dust fans.
fullTechnicalDescription: Heavy-duty peg-tooth threshing cylinder with reversible feed safety rollers preventing reverse recoil. Dual suction cyclone blowers achieve 99% grain purity for wheat, mustard, soybean, and gram. Equipped with high-clearance bagging elevator and automatic sieve grading.

specifications.Blower: Double aspiration fan for 99% dust and chaff removal

description: High throughput multi-crop thresher delivering clean, unbroken grains and fine straw for animal feed.
cancellationPolicy: Free cancellation up to 6 hours before arrival.
